missionPremise: P-105, operator go 2026-09-01 (row A-070). A share is the highest-intent moment the product gets and it currently ends in a static document whose live-view link is relative and therefore unresolvable by a foreign model. acceptanceItems.title: The human share carries the Sync handoff, from the existing builder.
acceptanceItems.how: api/_lib/pe-share-handoff.ts imports buildSyncPrompt, claudeWebChatUrl and claudeDesktopChatUrl from src/lib/claudeSync.ts. renderShareInstrumentHtml renders a Sync section that copies to the clipboard FIRST via an inline script, then opens the chat, and states both halves. The identity test runs a four-subject battery (resolved label, null label, label equal to the node id, a label past the 14,000-char guard) rather than one string, so a reimplementation has to reproduce all four contract rules to pass.

acceptanceItems.title: The agent formats carry a connector offer, not a deep link and not an instruction.
acceptanceItems.how: Markdown gets a Smart Site connector section and JSON gets connectorOffer; both name the connector, its URL, parcel_node_id, and get_smart_site. Copy is availability voice and is gated by readsAsDirective(), whose exclusion set (prohibitions like "do not invent a value" are NOT directives) is asserted in both directions. No claude:// in markdown or JSON; a paired test asserts claude:// IS on the HTML body so the absence is a choice rather than an unwired feature.
acceptanceItems.tension: Item 5 bans tool names in customer bodies while item 2 requires naming get_smart_site. Resolved by scope: INTERNAL_TOOL_NAMES lists the six export/refresh tools a share recipient cannot call; get_smart_site is allowlisted and that allowlist is itself asserted.

acceptanceItems.title: Every link in every format is absolute.
acceptanceItems.how: composeShareInstrument now REQUIRES an absolute origin, threaded from deployOrigin(req). absoluteShareUrl throws on a non-absolute origin, an unrooted path, or a fragment, so the failure mode is a refusal rather than a relative link. Two detectors: relativeUrlsIn() for link syntax (markdown/HTML) and relativePathValuesIn() walking the parsed JSON for rooted-path string values.
acceptanceItems.scopeLimit: The guarantee is over the fields this module CONSTRUCTS. The brief payload is passed through unchanged, as it always was; if an upstream brief field ever carried a rooted path the JSON body would carry it too. The test asserts over the whole parsed body, so the fixture is clean, but no production check runs.

acceptanceItems.title: Absence becomes four states, each with its own next action.
acceptanceItems.how: excluded-by-sharer, not-measured, tier-gated, absent-for-parcel (the card four) plus unread, which is the honest answer whenever the check did not run. Each carries an MCP disposition token (refused/unknown/absent/unread), a lay display sentence and an agentGuidance sentence in the shape tool-honesty.ts facetGuidance uses. The vocabulary is sourced from legacy-design-tools artifacts/smartsite-mcp, not invented. "Not verified on this share." no longer appears in any body.
acceptanceItems.checkShape: collapsedAbsenceStates() compares all five states PAIRWISE on BOTH halves and names the colliding pair. A single-render grep would have been presence-shaped and would pass on a table where every row said the same thing.

acceptanceItems.title: The duplication goes, and the developer strings with it.
acceptanceItems.how: The Artifacts block is now state-only ("X-ray: not on this share. See Withholdings.") and Withholdings is the single place a reason is stated, so the four repeated lines are gone. probeShareArtifact no longer has a slot for upstream prose: ShareArtifactState carries a classified absence instead of a reason string, and the upstream message is read by the classifier and then dropped. internalToolNamesIn() and httpStatusLeaksIn() run over all three rendered bodies.
acceptanceItems.detectorExclusionSet: httpStatusLeaksIn matches only (1) a parenthesised 1xx-5xx code, (2) HTTP <code>, (3) status/code/returned <code>. A bare three-digit scan would fire on real copy such as "No pipeline within 500 ft" and on parcel ids. A leak dressed some fourth way is NOT caught; that limit is asserted as a test, not merely described.
acceptanceItems.stubTrap: The first version of V5a mutated the write path but every fixture stubbed probeArtifact, so nothing would have failed. A permanent test now runs the REAL probeShareArtifact against the exact historical production payload.

acceptanceItems.title: One line stops asserting two contradictory facts.
acceptanceItems.how: The only place sharer intent is actually KNOWN is the share package include flag, which composeShareInstrument reads separately and maps to excluded-by-sharer. A download tool erroring is evidence about the artifact and says nothing about intent, so it maps to absent-for-parcel. The two lines are asserted mutually exclusive: the excluded line must not claim non-existence and the missing line must not mention the sharer.

webPrefill.theDisagreement: _sessions/2026-08-30_p91_v3_mcp_wave_claude_code.md line 39 states the mechanism was TESTED: "a https://claude.ai/new?q=<urlencoded> link opened a new chat with the prompt prefilled and Claude executed it against the connector." _decisions/2026-08-31_claude_sync_card_and_connected_signal.md line 59 states the browser form is undocumented and "prefill on web chat was reported removed in October 2025".
webPrefill.whyItCannotBeSettledHere: The parameter is handled client side inside an authenticated SPA. curl -o /dev/null https://claude.ai/new?q=test%20prompt returns 403 text/html, 5444 bytes, from this network with no session, so nothing about prefill is server observable. Settling it needs a logged-in browser, which this lane does not have.
webPrefill.whatIsAsymmetricAboutTheEvidence: The 08-30 record is an observation and an observation normally outranks a documentation status for "does it work". But it carries no snapshot: no test date, no browser, no account tier, no record of whether the composer was filled versus the message auto-sent. An undocumented query parameter can also change without notice, so even a true observation on 08-30 does not establish behaviour on 09-01.
webPrefill.consequence: None architecturally. Clipboard-first is correct under both readings, and this lane ships it unchanged. The share HTML copy says exactly what the workbench says: the chat is open AND the prompt is on the clipboard, paste it if the composer came up empty. That sentence is true whichever record is right, which is why it does not need this resolved.
webPrefill.toSettleIt: One operator run: open a share at /s/{grantId}?format=html, click Sync to Claude, and report whether the composer arrives filled, empty, or already sent.

LESSON: A multi-line source anchor written with \n silently fails to match a CRLF file, and a mutation-based violation battery then reports "could not reproduce" instead of "the check is wrong". Normalise anchors to the target file own line endings, and make anchor-not-found a distinct outcome from pass. This tree mixes endings depending on which tool wrote the file.

A source mutation only proves a check works if it can REACH that check. The first V5a mutated probeShareArtifact while every fixture stubbed it, so nothing would have failed and the battery would have reported a clean instrument. Before trusting a violation, ask what the mutated code path is actually gated on.

apps/property-explorer/tsconfig.json include:["src"] means the CI typecheck job passes with hard type errors in api/. Proven by violation on 2026-09-01. Any lane touching api/ must run its own api-scoped tsc and report before/after counts.

@vercel/node 3.2.29 build() sets baseDir = repoRootPath || workPath and traces with nodeFileTrace ts:true, compiling every traced .ts through its own register(). An api/ file may therefore import a .ts outside api/ as long as it is inside the repo root. Read from the package source, not inferred.

Embedding a server-built string in an inline <script> with JSON.stringify alone is an XSS hole when the string carries upstream data. Escape < and & to backslash-u forms. Found by reading the write path; no test failed and none would have.

The doc_repo concurrent-commit hazard fired again on 2026-09-01: a parallel session committed this lane’s seat_register.json edit into an unrelated F-01 commit. Registering a seat is a write to a hot shared file, and the window between writing it and the planner reviewing it is where it gets swept. Verify your entry in HEAD, not only in the working tree.
DEAD-END: Escaping U+2028/U+2029 in scriptSafeJson. Writing a literal line-separator character into source to match one is a byte that survives a checkout badly, and every runtime this ships to accepts those characters inside a string literal since ES2019. Dropped deliberately, with the reason in the code.

Trying to settle the claude.ai/new?q= prefill question with curl. The parameter is handled client side inside an authenticated SPA; an unauthenticated GET returns 403 and reveals nothing about prefill.
GROUND-TRUTH: Live share plane 2026-09-01: GET https://smartsite.cloud/s/<bogus-uuid> with Accept text/markdown returns 403 application/json, i.e. fail closed BEFORE negotiating. smartsite.cloud/llms.txt is live and matches api/_lib/pe-llms-txt.ts on every line checked.
